header: Retrieve Bypass Codes by User ID
content:
Returns a paged list of bypass code metadata associated with the user with ID
user_id . To fetch all results, call repeatedly with the offset  parameter as long as
{
"stat": "OK",
"response": [
"407176182",
"016931781",
"338390347",
"537828175",
"006165274",
"438680449",
"877647224",
"196167433",
"719424708",
"727559878"
]
}
the result metadata has a next_offset  value. Does not return the actual bypass
codes. Requires "Grant resource - Read" API permission.
